interface.shortDescription: Raise, monitor, and merge GitHub pull requests
interface.longDescription: A focused PR workflow for Codex: raise a pull request and start CodeRabbit review, monitor feedback and CI with permission-gated fixes, and merge only when review and CI gates are clear.
defaultPrompt: Use $raise-pr to open a PR and start CodeRabbit review.
Use $babysit-pr to inspect PR feedback and CI.
Use $merge-pr to merge when all gates pass.
